name: ship-it
description: Ship a change or coordinate an approved plan through independent issues, adversarial gates, PRs, CI, repository-required review, and merge.

interface.shortDescription: Ship a change or coordinate an approved plan
interface.longDescription: Implements a task description, GitHub issue, or Jira ticket, or coordinates an approved complex plan as an umbrella of independent issues. Each change passes risk-selected review and test gates, CI, and repository-required review before merge. Sail pauses when worker or gate agents are unavailable. Runs only when invoked by name.
defaultPrompt: Use $ship-it to implement and ship this change.
Use $ship-it to coordinate this approved plan as independent issues.
Use $ship-it to ship this GitHub issue.
Use $ship-it to ship this Jira ticket.
